in_marathi.name: Jamyatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jamyatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jamyatha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Yatha’, meaning ‘that which exists’. In Hindu mythology, Jamyatha is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted as a golden goddess holding a lotus in one hand and a pot of gold in the other. Her blessings are believed to bring abundance and prosperity to those who seek her favor.
